source_before: IC1984/85 CONTROL=2 private with profit unspecified

source_before: ICLEVEL=7 unclassified

source_before: UNITID 247719 shared by many different schools
source_after: No reliable unique UNITID for those records

interpretation: The 1986 file is not uniformly keyed one row per UNITID

source_after: From 1998 1=yes and 2=no; -3 not available
api_rule: Use nullable booleans and retain raw *_code
interpretation: Historical nonresponse is not zero/no

source_before: Legacy 1-9 urbanization scheme
source_after: Urban-centric 11-43 scheme
api_rule: Retain source code and attach locale_scheme

source_before: No header coordinates before 2009
source_after: Headers contain LONGITUD and LATITUDE
api_rule: Older years return missing coordinate fields
interpretation: Coordinate fields are strings in the current API

source_before: Earlier Carnegie vintages
source_after: C21BASIC identifies 2021 Basic classification
api_rule: Expose a versioned 2021 code only
interpretation: Do not treat different Carnegie vintages as the same category

source_before: ENRLFTM/W and ENRLPTM/W
source_after: ENRLM/W totals when supplied
api_rule: In 2001 sum full-time and part-time within sex before calculating yields
interpretation: Do not identify admitted applicants as SAT/ACT score submitters

source_before: IC20xx includes admissions questions
source_after: ADM20xx separate file
api_rule: Use year-specific configured endpoints
interpretation: File naming changed without implying all test-score columns exist annually

source_before: Earlier totals sometimes reconstructed from men+women
source_after: ADM2022+ also has supplemental another/unknown gender fields
api_rule: Use published totals when present and retain supplemental counts without adding them to binary categories
interpretation: Do not assume binary totals cover all reported genders or that SATPCT means share of admittees

source_before: ADMCON code 1 required 2 recommended 3 neither required nor recommended
source_after: ADMCON adds code 5 considered but not required
api_rule: Preserve the raw code and apply a year-aware label
interpretation: Policies are not a single invariant ordinal score

source_before: Old required/recommended/neither policy categories
source_after: New required/considered-if-submitted/not-considered categories; test optional/blind; essay/work/legacy added
api_rule: Map 1/5/3 using the 2022+ dictionary; leave unsupported prior-year fields missing
interpretation: Do not assign modern test-blind meanings to pre-2022 code 3

source_before: Submitted-test counts SATNUM/ACTNUM exist across 2001-2024
source_after: Score medians and supplemental gender counts enter ADM in 2022
api_rule: Keep 2001+ counts and 2022+ median fields without filling earlier years
interpretation: Score submitters are entering students not all applicants or all admittees

source_before: Undergraduate FT/PT LINE=1 and 15
source_after: Undergraduate FT/PT LINE=8 and 22
api_rule: Select the year-specific total student lines then sum by institution
interpretation: Do not sum the whole source file (subtotals duplicate students)

source_before: Graduate and first-professional LINE definitions change across 1984-2009
source_after: Modern LINE=11 and 25
api_rule: Apply year-specific grad_rules from cleaners.py
interpretation: Graduate populations are not guaranteed to be definitionally identical across years

source_before: Older EFRACE## categories and Asian/Pacific grouping
source_after: Modern EFTOTL/EFWHITM/EFASIAM etc
api_rule: Choose one naming regime per file before aggregation
interpretation: Historical race categories are not an exact crosswalk for later categories

source_before: EF-A fall totals without a distance indicator
source_after: Separate EF*_A_DIST with EFDELEV rows and EFDEEXC/EFDESOM/EFDENON
api_rule: Expose as a separate class and do not sum nested EFDELEV levels
interpretation: IPEDS distance courses deliver instructional content exclusively at a distance; these are student not course counts

source_before: EFDEEX1-5 are locations of exclusively distance students
source_after: Earlier EF2012A_DIST has trailing whitespace in EFDEEX5 header
api_rule: Trim raw column names and retain each location with its own X flag
interpretation: Location fields do not classify some-distance students

source_before: First-professional LSTUDY=2 separately reported
source_after: First-professional no longer separate from graduate level
api_rule: Expose first_professional only through 2010
interpretation: Old grad alone is not comparable to later graduate-including-professional counts

source_before: FYRACE20 combined Asian/Pacific Islander
source_after: EFYASIAT and EFYNHPIT separately reported
api_rule: Preserve combined older column separately; never sum it with later separated columns
interpretation: These race measures are not the same time series

source_before: LSTUDY level rows
source_after: Expanded EFFYALEV nested totals and details
api_rule: Select codes 1/2/12 for total/undergrad/grad rather than sum nested rows
interpretation: The total row overlaps level rows in student_level=all

source_before: Early EFIA has UG/graduate credit and UG contact hours but no FTE fields
source_after: EFIA2004 adds estimated and reported UG/graduate FTE and ACTTYPE
api_rule: Keep pre-2004 FTE and ACTTYPE missing; preserve estimated versus reported fields separately
interpretation: The reported FTE may fall back to NCES estimated FTE if an institution supplies none

source_before: No separate doctoral professional-practice FTE field
source_after: FTEDPP adds separately reported professional-practice doctoral FTE
api_rule: Leave earlier FTEDPP missing and do not auto-add it to graduate FTE
interpretation: Source unit is full-time equivalent rather than a count of awards or people

source_before: CNACTUA described as UG contact hours and ACTTYPE=1 contact
source_after: Same CNACTUA described as UG clock hours and ACTTYPE=1 clock
api_rule: Keep a common source field but label the year's hour terminology explicitly
interpretation: Do not add this activity to credit hours without a conversion and matched population

source_before: RET_PCF and RET_PCP percentages only
source_after: Cohort/exclusions/adjusted/retained source counts added
api_rule: Keep counts missing before 2007; retain published rate rather than recomputing
interpretation: Year denotes follow-up fall and cohort_year is prior fall

source_before: Adjusted cohort = cohort - exclusions
source_after: Study-abroad inclusions add to adjusted cohort
api_rule: Keep inclusion fields missing before first recorded 2016
interpretation: Missing does not mean a recorded zero

source_before: Separate IC*_AY / IC*_PY files
source_after: COST1_2024 combined academic and program reporters
api_rule: Separate reporter using CIPCODE1=-2 for academic in 2024
interpretation: Current price year is not the earlier prices repeated in a rolling file

source_before: IC2001_AY and IC2001_PY contain nonreporter rows
source_after: Other years generally split the populations
api_rule: Remove empty AY price rows and PY rows with CIPCODE1=-2
interpretation: Do not double-count the same institution-year

source_before: CHG1PY3 is price for entering students
source_after: CIPTUIT1 separately prices programs with no FTFT students
api_rule: Keep the two price populations in separate columns
interpretation: Do not add tuition and fees to manufacture CHG* published prices

source_before: SCFA1N/SCFA2 for academic or SCFY1N/SCFY2 for program
source_after: SCUGFFN/SCUGRAD common cohort fields when present
api_rule: Choose the matching reporter's denominator
interpretation: FTFT and all-undergraduate recipients are different populations

source_before: Early SFA federal/state/institutional grants and loans
source_after: FTFT Pell/federal loan breakdowns begin 2008; all-UG aid amounts from 2009
api_rule: Keep missing earlier years missing and preserve own subgroup denominators
interpretation: Grant recipient categories can overlap; dollar averages are per recipients not all students

source_before: SFA NPIST2 refers to aid-period average net price
source_after: COST2_2024 NPIST2 refers to 2023-24 aid year
api_rule: Left-join COST2 to SFA for year=2024 without dropping schools
interpretation: Net price is cost of attendance after qualifying grants; not tuition or a grant payment

source_before: SFAV is a separate institutional file from SFA
source_after: SFAV includes some graduate-only schools absent from SFA
api_rule: Expose it as VeteransAid instead of joining only to SFA
interpretation: Benefits are amounts known to institutions rather than every benefit a student receives

source_before: No MAJORNUM in pre-2001 A files
source_after: MAJORNUM=1 first or 2 second from C2001_A onward
api_rule: Default combines the post-2000 rows and marks earlier major_type unspecified; requested first/second before 2001 raises
interpretation: Earlier files do not prove that a major is first or second

source_before: Doctoral AWLEVEL=9
source_after: Doctoral award categories AWLEVEL=17-19
api_rule: Apply year-dependent doctoral filter and sum chosen categories within CIP
interpretation: These are awards by program and major not distinct people

source_before: Source CIP versions and code definitions change
source_after: C2025_A dictionary uses CIP 2020 classification
api_rule: Attach code labels by cip AND year rather than CIP alone
interpretation: Year-specific label matching is not a cross-version CIP crosswalk

source_before: C*_B gives one unduplicated institution total
source_after: C*_C counts distinct people within each AWLEVELC
api_rule: Use B for all awards or C for award-level and age measures
interpretation: Do not sum C levels into B or combine with CIP awards from C*_A

source_before: Certificate shorter than one year uses AWLEVELC=1
source_after: Certificates split into less-than-12-weeks=11 and 12-weeks-to-one-year=12
api_rule: Preserve raw and normalized code with year-specific readable labels
interpretation: One short-certificate code is not an invariant award category

source_before: GRTYPE 8 cohort / 9 bachelor completers; 29/30 associate
source_after: Same GR rows filtered by SECTION=2/4 and CHRTSTAT=12/13
api_rule: Pivot cohort/graduate counts and compute rate at 150% of normal time
interpretation: Graduation cohort/status year is not annual awards or FTFT retention year

source_before: GR200_08 supplemental collection
source_after: GR200_09 onward standard series
api_rule: Mark 2008 supplemental and preserve raw published rates
interpretation: GR200 status cohorts differ from the same-year 150% Graduation cohorts

source_before: Bachelor BA* cohort year=year-8
source_after: Less-than-four-year L4* cohort year=year-4
api_rule: Use appropriate source family and both adjusted denominators; do not recompute reported rates
interpretation: The less-than-four-year group includes certificates and is not synonymous with associate degrees

source_before: Earlier GR200 files have no BASTEND/L4STEND
source_after: From 2011 still-enrolled data exists; raw incremental flags are XBANC20A/XL4NC20A
api_rule: Keep earlier still_enrolled missing and use additional exclusions for 200% cohort
interpretation: Completed_150_to_200 is incremental while completed_200 is cumulative; published 2014 BAGR100 has an outlier 196

source_before: OMCHRT=1-4 identifies only four FT/PT first/non-first entrant groups
source_after: OMCHRT=10-52 adds overall totals and Pell/non-Pell subgroups
api_rule: Map codes by reporting year and label early Pell as not_collected
interpretation: Overall and Pell subgroup rows overlap their totals and must not be summed

source_before: Initial OM has separate six/eight-year adjusted cohort fields and no four-year outcomes
source_after: 2017+ has common revised/excluded/adjusted fields and 4/6/8-year outcome measures
api_rule: Expose both source schemas in distinct columns; earlier unavailable measures remain missing
interpretation: OMAWDP6/8 are published percentages not rates recomputed against a substituted modern denominator

source_before: OM2015 has OMFLAG for inconsistencies and OMRCHT8 for revised cohort at eight years
source_after: OM2016 has no OMFLAG or OMRCHT8; 2017 redesign changes denominator
api_rule: Preserve OMFLAG in 2015 and missing in later years without manufacturing 2016 OMRCHT8
interpretation: The 2015 file itself notes reported data inconsistencies

source_before: Initial six/eight-year awards lack award-type counts and OMENRUP
source_after: Expanded OM has highest-award category at 4/6/8 years and unknown-enrollment percentage at eight years
api_rule: Keep source counts and NCES percentages without deriving student-level awards elsewhere
interpretation: A subsequent enrollment elsewhere is not evidence of an award at that other institution

source_before: Older S/SAL occupational and contract categories
source_after: Modern 2010-SOC-based EAP/S*_OC/IS/SIS/NH and SAL*_IS/NIS
api_rule: Start modern seven-family API in 2012 and retain raw codes plus year-specific labels
interpretation: NCES says the SOC transition loses some occupation trend comparability

source_before: No explicit nine-month-equivalent salary average in SAL2012-15; weighted months information
source_after: SAL2016+ gives SAEQ9AM/W and separate month-specific counts/outlays/averages
api_rule: Leave earlier equated averages missing and mark the salary regime
interpretation: Do not splice pre-2016 salary months into a 2016+ nine-month-equivalent trend

source_before: Four-month July 1-October 31 new-hire window
source_after: Previous November 1-current October 31 twelve-month window
api_rule: Preserve each source count and report its 4/12-month exposure
interpretation: An increase in raw hire count across 2018 is not necessarily an employment trend

source_before: Older combined library/education-services and non-tenure contract classifications
source_after: Later occupational splits and multi-year versus indefinite non-tenure distinctions
api_rule: Retain category and occupation codes with year-specific NCES labels
interpretation: Identical high-level labels or numeric codes do not establish a longitudinal one-to-one occupation crosswalk

source_before: Salary files include SAAVMN* and SAMNTH* alongside equated and contract-specific salaries
source_after: Those months-worked fields are absent from SAL2018_IS onward
api_rule: Return later years missing while retaining direct month-specific averages where reported
interpretation: Absent monthly fields are not zero months of employment

source_before: SAL*_NIS has wide SANIN##/SANIT## occupation pairs
source_after: One long row per occupation code01-14 in API
api_rule: Keep both count/outlay and preserve overlapping occupation01 total
interpretation: No source sex breakdown or reported individual salary/median exists in this file

source_before: Older common-form and F1 to F1A transition files differ
source_after: Annual F1A public GASB plus F2 nonprofit/some public FASB plus F3 for-profit FASB
api_rule: Start curated API at FY2004 and retain the form per row
interpretation: No direct common-form/GASB/FASB longitudinal crosswalk is assumed

source_before: Prealigned finance reporting structures
source_after: Aligned GASB/FASB form reporting
api_rule: Label era and preserve source amounts without splicing old and new into an assumed equivalent series
interpretation: Gross versus net tuition and aid treatment and operating classifications differ by form

source_before: F3 has F3B02 statement expenses without functional F3E011/F3E071
source_after: F3 adds functional expense and instruction amounts
api_rule: Keep pre-2014 F3 functional amounts missing and never substitute F3B02 for F3E071
interpretation: F3B02 and F3E071 sometimes differ even when both are reported

source_before: F3 form before the 2014-15 collection redesign
source_after: F3 revised balance-sheet reporting from FY2014
api_rule: Mark F3-specific accounting era from fiscal 2014
interpretation: Collection year 2014-15 refers to FY2014 finance rather than FY2015

source_before: No F1E12/F2C12/F3C12 detailed Pell discount totals
source_after: All three forms collect Pell-funded discounts and allowances
api_rule: Leave pre-2020 values and flags missing instead of zero
interpretation: Pell grants can be pass-through or discounts depending on accounting treatment
